# Poly Haven surface textures

Photographed stone from Poly Haven (https://polyhaven.com), **CC0 1.0**
(https://polyhaven.com/license): free for any use, no attribution required.
Each folder's `info.json` names the texture, its authors, its page and its
real-world size. They are downloaded by `tools/art/fetch_polyhaven.py`
(1k JPG: colour, OpenGL normal, roughness); do not edit them by hand.

- `stone_tiles_02` (Stone Tiles 02, Charlotte Baglioni): look B's floors.
- `rock_wall_08` (Rock Wall 08, Amal Kumar): look B's walls, pillars and gates.
